subject: Request: SOC 2 / SIG — encrypted key custody timeline & HSM proofs
messages:
From: Mike Liu <mike.liu@peregrine.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 4 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 / SIG request — key custody timeline & HSM proofs

Hi Kimberly,

As part of Peregrine's SOC 2 / SIG review for our platform integration, our security team needs a short package describing Redwood's encryption key custody and HSM evidence. Specifically we’re looking for: 

- A concise timeline of key custody responsibilities (who holds wrapping keys vs tenant keys) and any transition points (e.g., BYOK handoffs).
- The latest HSM attestation (or vendor statement) showing hardware-backed key protection for root/wrapping keys.
- Rotation policy summary + sample rotation logs for the last 12 months (redacted is fine).
- Keystore manifest (which key types are in use, associated metadata).

Can you confirm what you can provide and whether you can do a short 30–45 minute walkthrough/demo of the attestation artifacts next week? Ideally we’d have the documents by EOD Wed (May 10) so our control owners can review ahead of the walkthrough.

Thanks — happy to loop in legal if needed.

Best,
Mike
Mike Liu
Senior InfoSec Manager, Peregrine Financial
security@peregrine.com


From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Mike Liu <mike.liu@peregrine.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 May 2028 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG request — key custody timeline & HSM proofs

Hi Mike — thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything you requested; below is a high-level summary and proposed timeline. I’m attaching a redacted keystore manifest, our most recent HSM attestation (vendor statement with redactions), and our key rotation playbook.

High level answers (short):
- Custody model: Redwood separates tenant encryption keys from root/wrapping keys. Tenant keys are either customer-managed (BYOK) or tenant-scoped keys stored in our KMS layer; wrapping and root keys for our hosted environment are backed by hardware HSM instances (managed through our KMS provider).
- Hand-offs: For BYOK customers we perform a sealed key import/handshake; responsibility transfers to the customer once imported. We can provide the import audit events for the handoff.
- Rotation cadence: Tenant-scoped ephemeral keys are rotated automatically (default 90 days) depending on workload; root/wrapping key rotation is performed annually with documented change windows and emergency rotation procedures.
- Logs & evidence: We’ll provide redacted rotation logs (timeline + key identifiers), the HSM attestation PDF, and a keystore manifest CSV.

Proposed next steps / timeline:
- Today (Thu): initial packet sent (attached, redacted) — keystore_manifest_redacted.csv, hsm_attestation_redacted.pdf, rotation_playbook_v2.docx.
- Tue May 9: live walkthrough & attestation Q&A (30–45m) — propose 10:00am PT.
- Wed May 10 EOD: provide the redacted 12-month rotation log extract and import audit events.

If that works I’ll ask Marissa to pull the logs and Rachel to prep the redaction checklist. Please confirm the walkthrough time or propose an alternative. If you need an NDA or any additional legal formality before we share unredacted artifacts, let us know and we’ll coordinate.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference
attachments: keystore_manifest_redacted.csv (csv), hsm_attestation_redacted.pdf (pdf), rotation_playbook_v2.docx (docx)

Kim / Rachel — I’ll pull the rotation logs and the import audit events today. Plan:

- Generate 12-month rotation log extract (redact tenant IDs and any PII) — target: Fri May 5 EOD.
- Export BYOK import handshake events (timestamps + event ids) — target: Fri May 5 EOD.
- Prepare a short summary (one page) mapping each artifact to the SIG/SOC control language (control IDs) — target: Mon May 8 morning.

I’ll upload the artifacts to the shared Drive folder and flag any items that require legal redaction. Rachel, can you confirm we have the HSM vendor attestation in the secure artifact store and whether it needs an additional signature?

Marissa
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Mike Liu <mike.liu@peregrine.com>

Cc: Sara White <sara.white@peregrine.com>
Date: Fri, 5 May 2028 14:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG request — key custody timeline & HSM proofs

Kim, Marissa — this looks great, thanks for the quick turnaround and clear plan. We’ve tentatively scheduled the walkthrough for Tue May 9 at 10:00am PT (I’ll send a calendar invite). Sara from legal is cc’d — she may request a short mutual NDA before we look at any unredacted logs.

Two quick clarifications we’ll want covered in the walkthrough:
- Can you demonstrate the import handshake (audit events) for a sample BYOK customer without exposing secrets?
- For the HSM attestation, can you explain the chain of custody for the wrapping keys and whether you maintain any key backups outside the HSM?

If you can cover those two items we should be set for Peregrine’s control owners. Thanks again — see you next week.

Best,
Mike
Senior InfoSec Manager, Peregrine Financial
